common.liveNote: This campaign is live on Meta — your edits are sent to Meta when you press Publish.

help.campaignBody: Choose the objective that matches what you want to achieve. You'll set the audience, placements and budget in the next steps, then build the ad creative.

campaign.objectiveSubtitle: Your objective decides how your ads are optimized and where results show.
campaign.categoriesSubtitle: Declare whether your ads relate to financial products, employment, housing, social issues, elections or politics.
campaign.abBody: Compare versions of your ads to learn what performs best. You can set up the test in Meta after publishing.
campaign.cboBody: Distribute your budget across ad sets automatically to get more results.

adset.conversionSubtitle: Where do you want to get results?
adset.pickObjectiveFirst: Choose the campaign objective first to see conversion locations.
adset.bidOnCampaign: Bid strategy is set on the campaign: {{strategy}}

budget.title: Budget & schedule
budget.label: Budget
budget.onCampaign: The budget is managed on the campaign (Advantage campaign budget).
budget.lifetimeNeedsEnd: A lifetime budget needs an end date on every ad set.

audience.title: Audience
audience.subtitle: Define who you want to see your ads.
audience.saveHint: Save these audience settings to reuse them in other ad sets.
audience.pinModeOn: Click the map to drop a pin

locationTypes.home_recent: People living in or recently in this location

audience.bulkHint: Type one place per line (country, region, city or postcode).
audience.advantageBody: Let Meta find your audience automatically, treating the settings below as suggestions. Recommended.
audience.advantageNote: Age, gender and detailed targeting below are treated as suggestions — Meta may go beyond them (location and minimum age are always respected).
audience.languagesHint: Leave empty to reach people in all languages.

placements.title: Placements
placements.subtitle: Choose where your ad appears across Meta technologies.
placements.advantageBody: Your budget is spread across every placement likely to perform best.
placements.manualBody: Choose the platforms and positions yourself. This may limit delivery.
placements.leaveEmpty: Leave positions unselected to show in every position of the chosen platforms.

audience_network.classic: Audience Network native, banner and interstitial

ON_AD.title: On your ad
ON_AD.desc: Get more post engagement or video views.

MESSAGING_APPS.title: Messenger, Instagram & WhatsApp
MESSAGING_APPS.desc: Start conversations in whichever app people prefer.

WEBSITE.title: Website
WEBSITE.desc: Get engaged visitors on your website.

INSTAGRAM_PROFILE.title: Instagram profile
INSTAGRAM_PROFILE.desc: Send people to your Instagram profile.

CALLS.title: Calls
CALLS.desc: Get people to call your business.

INSTANT_FORMS.title: Instant forms
INSTANT_FORMS.desc: Collect leads with a form inside Facebook and Instagram.

ad.identitySubtitle: Choose how your business appears in the ad.
ad.formatSingleBody: One image or one video in your ad.
ad.formatCarouselBody: Two or more scrollable images or videos.
ad.noLeadForms: Your Page has no lead forms. Create one in Meta, then sync.
ad.creativeSubtitle: Add media and text for your ad.
ad.mediaHint: Recommended: 1080×1080 (Feed) or 1080×1920 (Stories/Reels). JPG or PNG, up to 30MB.
ad.cardLink: Website URL (optional, uses the ad URL)
ad.primaryTextPlaceholder: Tell people what your ad is about...
ad.textOptionsHint: The first text is published with the ad; extra options are kept for later variations.
ad.headline: Headline
ad.ctaForced: The button is set automatically for messaging destinations.
ad.displayLinkPlaceholder: The link people see, e.g. example.com/offer
ad.urlParamsHint: Added to your website URL for tracking. Example: utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=paid
ad.advantageBody: Let Meta enhance media and text automatically when it's likely to improve performance (standard enhancements).

tracking.title: Tracking
tracking.subtitle: Track the conversions that matter to your business.
tracking.noPixel: No Pixel is set up on this ad account.

preview.title: Ad preview
preview.addMedia: Add media to preview your ad

reach.title: Audience definition
reach.pickLocation: Choose a location to see the estimate
reach.disclaimer: Estimates may vary significantly over time based on your targeting and available data, and are not a guarantee of results.

publish.successBody: The campaign, its ad sets and ads were created. Meta reviews ads before they start delivering, which can take a while.

issues.campaignBudgetRequired: Enter the campaign budget (Advantage campaign budget is on).
issues.noAdsets: Add at least one ad set.
issues.goalInvalid: The performance goal doesn't fit the chosen objective and conversion location.
issues.billingEventInvalid: The billing event doesn't fit the performance goal.
issues.pageRequired: This goal needs a Facebook Page linked to the ad account.
issues.pixelRequired: This goal needs a Pixel on the ad account.
issues.appRequired: Add the app ID and app store URL to the ad account.
issues.bidAmountRequired: Enter a bid amount for the chosen bid strategy.
issues.endTimeRequired: A lifetime budget needs an end date.
issues.endBeforeStart: The end date must be after the start date.
issues.ageRangeInvalid: The minimum age is above the maximum age.
issues.advantageAgeMax: With Advantage+ audience the maximum age must be 65+ (Meta treats it as a suggestion).
issues.advantageAgeMin: With Advantage+ audience the minimum age can't be above 25.
issues.placementsRequired: Choose at least one platform or use Advantage+ placements.
issues.placementsNeedFacebook: Messenger and Audience Network also need Facebook selected.
issues.noAds: Add at least one ad to this ad set.
issues.adPageRequired: No Facebook Page is linked to the ad account.
issues.mediaRequired: Add an image or a video.
issues.carouselMinCards: A carousel needs at least two cards.
issues.carouselCardMedia: Add an image or video to every card.
issues.primaryTextTooLong: The primary text is too long.
issues.linkInvalid: The URL isn't valid (it must start with https://).
issues.phoneLinkRequired: Enter the phone number as tel:+20…
issues.cardLinkInvalid: One of the card URLs isn't valid.
